title: New York's 3rd Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for New York's 3rd Congressional District will determine who represents the North Shore of Nassau County and parts of northeastern Queens in the U.S. House. The district is a competitive swing seat currently held by Democratic incumbent Tom Suozzi, who won a closely contested 2024 general election with 51.8% of the vote after flipping the seat from scandal-plagued Republican George Santos. Suozzi faces a primary challenge from progressive public defender Danielle Welch, while the Republican primary features a rematch between 2024 nominee and former state assemblyman Mike LiPetri and attorney Greg Hach. Rated "Lean Democratic" by the Cook Political Report, this race is expected to be one of the key battlegrounds for control of the House in the 2026 midterm elections.
polling_note: No public opinion polls specific to the 2026 NY-03 general election were found as of June 2026. Prediction markets and race ratings (Cook Political Report: Lean D) are available but no candidate-vs-candidate survey data was identified.

candidates.name: Tom Suozzi
candidates.summary: Tom Suozzi is the incumbent Democratic U.S. Representative for New York's 3rd Congressional District, first elected in 2016 and returning to Congress via a February 2024 special election after the expulsion of George Santos. A former Nassau County Executive (2002-2009) and mayor of Glen Cove (1994-2001), he is a CPA and attorney who has focused on fiscal responsibility, environmental cleanup, and bipartisan problem-solving. He previously ran for Governor of New York in 2006 and 2022.

candidates.name: Danielle Welch
candidates.summary: Danielle Welch is a career public defender at The Legal Aid Society in New York City and a first-generation college graduate challenging incumbent Tom Suozzi in the Democratic primary. She grew up in a military family in Virginia, earned her undergraduate degree from the University of Pittsburgh and her law degree from NYU School of Law on full scholarships, and has worked as a public defender since 2015. Her campaign emphasizes progressive positions including universal healthcare, criminal justice reform, taxing the ultra-wealthy, and expanding social programs.

candidates.name: Mike LiPetri
candidates.summary: Mike LiPetri is a former New York State Assemblyman (2019-2021) for the 9th District and the 2024 Republican nominee for NY-03, losing to incumbent Tom Suozzi by 3.6 points. A South Farmingdale native and attorney, he has been endorsed by President Donald Trump and Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman for his 2026 campaign. His campaign focuses on affordability, border security, supporting law enforcement, and standing with Israel.

candidates.name: Greg Hach
candidates.summary: Greg Hach is an attorney, U.S. Air Force veteran, and co-founder of the personal injury firm Hach & Rose, LLP, which has recovered over $1 billion for injured New Yorkers. He grew up in Hicksville, Long Island in a union family, served during the Cold War era, and previously challenged incumbent George Santos in the 2024 Republican primary. His campaign focuses on conservative priorities including border security, supporting President Trump, and fighting for Long Island working families.
